limits: First official resources require Internet, Java ownership/terms consent and one archive up to 150 MiB. The private-use legal basis is a project interpretation, not blanket asset rights.

Saved texture-property heads only; UUID/name-only heads, piglin/dragon geometry, full shield entity geometry, world compass/clock context, effect-derived potion colours and complex executable renderers remain unavailable or partial.
98/132 representative vanilla/component visuals and 6/6 Adorn visuals are not exhaustive registry/mod/pack coverage.
Declared mod licences may not cover separately restricted embedded art; preview resource order does not claim the player client pack stack.
CI skips the private owned-game visual case. macOS also skips the Bedrock directory import because the dedicated server has no macOS distribution; platform-specific unit cases are explicitly skipped.
Actual connected-client inventory/gameplay, Bedrock/PocketMine gameplay and exhaustive engine/mod/version combinations remain unvalidated.
Historical Windows upgrade evidence targets administration candidate 815f4a7, not these image binaries. No public 0.5.0 feed or download replay exists.
Windows/Apple publisher certificates and notarization are unavailable; updater metadata signatures are a separate integrity check.
No merge, tag or v0.5.0 release until separate owner approval.
